root_cause_criterion.criterion: After UA_Nodestore_insert transfers ownership of the new node into the nodestore, Operation_addNode_begin must identify that node to addParentAndTypeRef by its node-id selector `&node->nodeId`, not by the raw `node` alias. Otherwise the helper can delete the nodestore entry while the caller still treats `node` as a live delete target.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the rooted addParentAndTypeRef call with helper_selector_expr=`node`, while the fixed original reaches the same source event with helper_selector_expr=`&node->nodeId`. That is the missing source-level obligation that distinguishes whether the helper operates on a nodestore-managed identity or the caller's stale raw alias.

nodes.state: When addParentAndTypeRef returns an error, Operation_addNode_begin still passes the same raw `node` pointer to UA_Nodestore_delete(server, node) even though deleteNodeOperation already released and freed that nodestore entry.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records helper_delete_release.released_node_ptr == caller_cleanup_delete.cleanup_delete_arg.

nodes.state: The second UA_Nodestore_delete path reaches NodeId_deleteMembers with `p` equal to the freed node's base address, so `switch(p->identifierType)` branches on stale node-id bytes from the double-deleted entry.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records caller_cleanup_delete.cleanup_delete_arg == nodeid_delete_sink.nodeid_ptr for the sink call that follows the second delete.

edges.relation: The helper's deleteNodeOperation releases the same node storage that Operation_addNode_begin immediately reuses as the argument to its own UA_Nodestore_delete cleanup, establishing the free-before-reuse temporal violation.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records helper_delete_release.released_node_ptr == caller_cleanup_delete.cleanup_delete_arg.

edges.relation: The stale `node` pointer passed to the caller's second UA_Nodestore_delete reaches NodeId_deleteMembers as the sink's `p` argument, because the node-id subobject is the first base member cleaned during UA_Node_deleteMembers.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records caller_cleanup_delete.cleanup_delete_arg == nodeid_delete_sink.nodeid_ptr for the sink call that follows the second delete.
